rules.name: hermes-identity-sentence
rules.pattern: (?i)You are Hermes Agent,?\s*an intelligent AI assistant created by Nous Research\.?
rules.replacement: You are Hermes, an AI assistant.

rules.name: pi-harness-identity
rules.pattern: (?i)You are a coding assistant running inside pi,\s*a coding agent harness\.

rules.name: claude-code-dual-use
rules.pattern: (?i)Dual-use security tools \([^)]*\) require clear authorization context:[^.\n]*\.
rules.replacement: Tools with both offensive and defensive uses need a clear, authorized purpose.

rules.name: dsh-harness-identity
rules.pattern: (?i)You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness\.
rules.replacement: You are an AI agent powered by an agent runtime.

rules.name: browser-dom-context
rules.pattern: (?i)The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context\.
rules.replacement: The browser provides no implicit DOM context.

rules.name: zcode-identity-sentence
rules.pattern: (?i)You are ZCode,?\s*an?\s+interactive agent that helps (?:users|developers) with software engineering tasks\.
rules.replacement: You are an AI agent that helps users with software engineering tasks.

rules.name: zcode-safety-guidelines
rules.pattern: (?i)You must always follow safety guidelines:\s*refuse to assist with destructive techniques[^.\n]*\.
rules.replacement: Always follow the applicable safety guidelines.

rules.name: zcode-dual-use
rules.pattern: (?i)Dual-use security tools require clear authorization context\.
rules.replacement: Tools with both offensive and defensive uses need a clear, authorized purpose.
